scripts.build:pages: tsc --noEmit && VITE_ANALYTICS_APPROVED=false VITE_CRM_INTAKE_APPROVED=false VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY= PAGES_BASE_PATH=/27pm vite build --mode github-pages
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:approved && npm run test:e2e:inactive && npm run test:e2e:fallback
scripts.test:e2e:approved: VITE_ANALYTICS_APPROVED=true VITE_CRM_INTAKE_APPROVED=true VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY=1x00000000000000000000AA npm run build && ANALYTICS_TEST_APPROVED=true CRM_TEST_PROFILE=approved playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:inactive: VITE_ANALYTICS_APPROVED=false VITE_CRM_INTAKE_APPROVED=false VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY=1x00000000000000000000AA npm run build && ANALYTICS_TEST_APPROVED=false CRM_TEST_PROFILE=inactive playwright test --grep "keeps unapproved analytics dormant|keeps CRM intake dormant without explicit approval"
scripts.test:e2e:fallback: VITE_ANALYTICS_APPROVED=false VITE_CRM_INTAKE_APPROVED=false VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY= npm run build && ANALYTICS_TEST_APPROVED=false CRM_TEST_PROFILE=fallback playwright test --grep "keeps the mail fallback when CRM configuration is absent"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:seo
